text: 15.1 1 Oh, Sue! Are you okay? Let me help you up. Thanks. Ow! Careful. Have you hurt your wrist? No, I don't think so. Ouch! Put your arm round my shoulder. Can you stand? Yes, but I can't put any weight on it. I think I might have broken my ankle. Sit down. I'll get Mike to take you to the hospital. Oh.
